implementation: Robot Black Box public reference monorepo

limitations: The public profile accepts bounded synthetic event types rather than arbitrary production payloads.
The recorder uses a local SQLite store and does not establish multi-region durability.
Historical demonstration pins are supplied with the fixture and are not independent enrollment.
Published cases use synthetic or retained simulation inputs rather than calibrated physical sensors.
Roles, keys and retained copies remain on one host and do not demonstrate independent custody or media-loss recovery.
No catalog, object store, stream processor or query engine is deployed by the public reference profile.
The bridge maps local evidence interfaces and does not prove hosted synchronization or regulatory compliance.
Requires separately administered trust, storage, timestamping and recovery infrastructure.
The repository ships no actuator control, safety interlock or qualified physical-hardware integration.
No aviation, product-safety or functional-safety certification claim is made.
